description_en: Queries information about one or more tasks in the recycle bin
description_zh: 查询回收站中的一个或多个任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun nas list-recycle-bin-jobs --file-system-id 1ca4040000 --job-id rb-150000ed-r-162500002441 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --status All --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRecycleBinJobs

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的行数。

取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the current page in a paged query.

Start value (default value): 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时当前的页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.
Defragmenting: Data is being defragmented.
PartialSuccess: The task partially succeeded.
Success: The task succeeded.
Fail: The task failed.
Cancelled: The task is canceled.
All (default): All statuses
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Running：运行中
Defragmenting：数据整理中
PartialSuccess：部分运行成功
Success：运行成功
Fail：运行失败
Cancelled：已取消
All（默认值）：全部
parameters.name: status
